risk_if_not_implemented: Without Risk Owner, residual security, compliance, or resilience risk may accumulate without structured oversight, leading to unmanaged exposures.

compensating_control_1.name: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to assign one or more qualified individuals with the mission and resources to centrally-manage, coordinate, develop, implement and maintain an enterprise-wide Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).
compensating_control_1.justification: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities (GOV-04) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Risk Owner (RSK-03.2) by ensuring the organization can restore operations when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Remediation
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to remediate risks to an acceptable level.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Remediation (RSK-06) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Risk Owner (RSK-03.2) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses and prioritizing critical remediations. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
